messages:
jamal_sales: Heads-up: Avalon Health wants to start a 2-week POC but dropped a long identity/security list. Core asks: SAML SSO, SCIM delta provisioning with group sync, RBAC via IdP groups, delegated tenant admin capability, domain ownership lock, EU residency for PHI, and clarity on hosted vs dedicated pricing.

alex_k: OK. Do we have their expected user counts and provisioning pattern? Any hard SLA for provisioning latency?

jamal_sales: They plan ~800 users at launch, likely ~8k in 12 months. They may perform bulk imports and want near-realtime provisioning (<30s) for hires. Delegated admin is required for their internal ops.

maria_product: Product notes: Hosted supports SAML + SCIM v2 and group mapping. Hosted SCIM default throttle is 200 req/min; Dedicated can be configured higher and supports webhook-driven flows for faster provisioning. Delegated admin and customer-managed KMS are Private/Dedicated features. EU-only residency available on Dedicated/Private (eu-west-1 / eu-central-1).

olivia_sec: Security: they sent our vendor questionnaire. Need SOC2 Type II, TLS, AES-256 at rest, KMS options, and PHI handling language. I can pull SOC2 and the redwood-sec-package in ~48h. Legal will need ~72h for KMS/PHI contract language.

ben_eng: SCIM details: we support Okta delta token flow and a bulk endpoint. Example user patch payload we accept: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@avalon.example",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Wu"},
  "emails": [{"value":"alice@avalon.example","primary":true}],
  "groups": [{"value":"clinical","display":"Clinical"}]
}
```

ben_eng: For <30s provisioning recommend Okta outbound webhooks or run POC on Dedicated with raised rate limits.

jamal_sales: They also asked for SAML metadata example and attribute names. Can someone paste a minimal snippet?

alex_k: SAML example to forward:
```
<saml2:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com">
  <md:SPSSODescriptor>
    <md:AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.example.com/sso/callback"/>
  </md:SPSSODescriptor>
</saml2:EntityDescriptor>
```
Attributes: `email`, `givenName`, `familyName`, `name`, `groups` (as array).

maria_product: Pricing: Hosted covers SCIM up to 5k active identities; above that a provisioning surcharge per additional 1k applies. Dedicated = reserved capacity + platform fee; domain-lock and delegated admin tooling are Private features with one-time onboarding + monthly. I will draft a ballpark but need provisioning peak numbers.

olivia_sec: I'll assemble questionnaire answers + SOC2 and attach redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf in 48h. Anything needing contractual amendments (KMS, PHI clauses) will need legal review (~72h).

maria_product: Action items: (1) Jamal to request their Okta SCIM adapter config, delta token examples, and peak provisioning estimates; (2) Olivia to collate sec artifacts and list legal items in 48h; (3) Ben to prepare a one-pager on provisioning latency options (webhooks vs Dedicated throttles) and SCIM mapping examples; (4) I'll prepare hosted vs dedicated pricing ballpark and migration notes.

jamal_sales: Avalon wants POC next Monday. Can we scope POC to include SSO, SCIM group sync, and domain verification but exclude delegated admin and customer KMS?

maria_product: Yes—Hosted POC can run SSO + SCIM + domain proofing. Delegated admin and customer-managed KMS require Dedicated/Private onboarding. We'll call that out in the SOW and include migration steps.

jamal_sales: Great. I'll confirm scope and request their SCIM/Okta logs. Tagging @olivia_sec @ben_eng. :thumbsup: 

sec_bot: Reminder: attach redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf when responding to security questionnaires — https://internal.redwood.com/sec/redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf

jamal_sales: Sent SAML and SCIM guidance to the customer and attached the sec package link. Will update when they return the Okta adapter config and delta logs.
